claim: Jerez (XRY) is the closest airport at a 30-minute drive via the A4; the C-1 line links El Puerto to Cadiz (35 min, EUR 3.90) and Jerez (10 min); 3 daily direct Alvia trains run from Madrid Atocha.
quote: Jerez (XRY) is the closest option, 30-minute drive via the A4... The C-1 line connects El Puerto to Cadiz (35 minutes, EUR3.90) and Jerez (10 minutes). 3 daily Alvia trains direct to Cadiz run from Madrid's Atocha station

claim: The El Vapor ferry runs nine daily crossings on winter weekdays (four on weekends) at EUR 2.80, matching train speed but cheaper; rough seas trigger a bus replacement service.
quote: Winter weekday service includes nine daily crossings (four on weekends) at EUR2.80, matching train speed but costing less. When seas are rough, 'ship replacement service' uses buses instead.

claim: Local buses in El Puerto run every 30-40 minutes at EUR 1; a taxi from the station to downtown averages EUR 4; the walkable centre crosses in 45-50 minutes on foot.
quote: Local buses operate every 30-40 minutes at EUR1 per ride. Taxis average EUR4 from the station to downtown. The walkable city center takes 45-50 minutes to traverse on foot

claim: The El Vapor catamaran crossing takes roughly 30-40 minutes, departs from the riverside El Vapor terminal in El Puerto and docks at Muelle Ciudad in central Cadiz; the Consorcio de Transportes de la Bahia de Cadiz operates it.
quote: Crossing Time: approximately 30-40 minutes... terminal is located at the riverside... known as 'El Vapor'... Ferries dock at 'Muelle Ciudad,' positioning passengers directly in Cadiz's historic center... Consorcio de Transportes de la Bahia de Cadiz operates the service

claim: El Puerto forms one corner of the Sherry Triangle with Jerez and Sanlucar; the catamaran from the harbour by Plaza de San Juan crosses to Cadiz in about 20 minutes for EUR 2.80 each way, and Jerez is a 20-minute drive.
quote: the great sherry triangle that connects with Jerez de la Frontera and Sanlucar de Barrameda... take the catamaran ferry from the harbor in front of Plaza de San Juan. The frequent, 20-minute crossing costs 2.80EUR each way... Jerez de la Frontera. It is a 20-minute drive

claim: The Feria de Primavera y Fiesta del Vino Fino (Spring Fair) 2026 runs April 29 to May 4 on the Las Banderas fairground, with every fair-tent open to the public unlike Seville or Cordoba.
quote: La Feria de El Puerto de Santa Maria 2026 takes place from April 29 to May 4... the huge Las Banderas fairground becomes filled with fair-tents... Unlike the more exclusive fairs of Seville or Cordoba, every single tent here is open to the public

claim: Semana Santa (Holy Week) processions in El Puerto in 2026 begin on Palm Sunday, March 29.
quote: Holy Week processions are scheduled to begin on Palm Sunday, March 29, 2026

claim: The Crisol Monasterio de San Miguel hotel occupies a baroque 1727 convent built for the Capuchin Poor Clares by the Duke of Medinaceli, with 164 rooms close to the beach, shops and monuments.
quote: Monasterio San Miguel, a gracious baroque building and converted convent which dates back to 1727... built by order of the Duke of Medinaceli to house the Clarisas Capuchinas nuns... 164 sober and elegant rooms... close to the beach, the main shopping streets

claim: Hotel Puerto Sherry is a 60-room nautical-themed waterfront hotel beside the Puerto Sherry marina just outside town, with a rooftop terrace and seasonal outdoor pool.
quote: nautical-themed hotel is located in Puerto Sherry, just outside of El Puerto de Santa Maria, near the marina... rooftop terrace and seasonal outdoor pool... 60 rooms

claim: Jerez is famous for sherry, flamenco and Carthusian horses; the Royal Andalusian School of Equestrian Art runs its 'How the Andalusian Horses Dance' show midday on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the Feria del Caballo runs 9-16 May 2026.
quote: Jerez is famous for three things: sherry wine, flamenco, and Carthusian horses... the famous show 'How the Andalusian Horses Dance,' available midday on Tuesdays & Thursdays... The Feria del Caballo runs 9-16 May 2026

claim: From Seville Airport travellers take the EA bus to Santa Justa station then a direct Renfe train to El Puerto (roughly 55 minutes total via Cercanias/MD), with fares from about EUR 9-18 one way.
quote: hop on the EA airport bus to Santa Justa station, then take the Cercanias C-1 train... El Puerto de Santa Maria around 55 minutes... direct train to El Porto... cost is around 18EUR one way
